title: PlasmaZones Wallpaper Shader Metadata
description: metadata.json for a bundled or user wallpaper-shader pack. Core identity and the parameter contract are enforced. Optional multipass, buffer (including halfFloatBuffers), and wallpaper rendering keys, plus descriptive metadata (category, description, author, version), are type-checked so a wrong-typed value is rejected at the gate rather than silently swallowed by a typed accessor at load.

presets.description: Named parameter presets. Each value is a map of parameter id to value. Image-typed values are pack-declared paths and are containment-checked at load like an image param's default.

type.description: Marshalling type of the uniform (image binds a texture slot). An unknown type cannot be bound, so it is rejected.

default.description: Default value. Use a string for color (#rrggbb), a number for float or int, and a boolean for bool.

slot.description: Explicit UBO lane. 31 is the scalar-pool ceiling, and the color pool tops out at 15 with the image pool at 3, which the pack validator lints per type.

unit.description: Unit the value is expressed in. Omit for a plain number. "px" declares logical pixels of the real surface the shader draws on, which a host rendering at reduced size (a settings preview) scales down by that reduction so the effect reads as a faithful miniature rather than one several times too coarse.
